title: CBDT Extends Deadlines for Valuers and Tax Practitioners, Revises Forms
content:
# CBDT Extends Deadlines for Valuers and Tax Practitioners, Revises Forms

Ek important update hai Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) ki taraf se! Government ne Valuers aur Tax Practitioners ke registration deadlines ko extend kar diya hai aur saath hi related forms ko revise bhi kiya hai.

This is a fast update for all professionals.

*   **Notification Details:** The extension and form revisions have been announced via **Notification G.S.R. 822(E) dated September 17, 2026**.
*   **Extended Due Date:** The deadline for registration of valuers under Section 514 and authorized income tax practitioners under Section 515 of the Income-tax Act, 2025 (as per Income-tax Rules, 2026) has been extended. The previous due date was September 30, 2026, which is now extended to **March 31, 2027**.
*   **Forms Revised:** The notification also replaces the prescribed application forms for these categories of professionals. This includes revisions to forms like Form 169 and Form 171.
*   **What this means:** This extension provides more time for eligible individuals to complete their registration process under the new Income-tax Rules, 2026.
